blocks.md: ***In the presence of ultraviolet (UV) radiation, methane reacts with bromine in a substitution reaction***
- The equation for the reaction is
- Chlorine will also react with alkanes under the same conditions to form chloromethane

- The products belong to a family called halogenoalkanes or haloalkanes
- Halogenoalkanes have many uses a solvents, refrigerants, propellants and pharmaceuticals

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: CFC stands for chlorofluorocarbon, an important class of halogenoalkanes, previously used in fridges and air conditioners, but gradually being phased out because of the damage they cause to the ozone layer.
